subject: physiology
title: The Endometrial Cycle, Two-Cell Theory, and Menopause

steps.tx: Following completion of menstrual shedding, rising concentrations of 17-beta estradiol secreted by developing ovarian follicles stimulate rapid mitotic regeneration of the uterine mucosa from the preserved stratum basale. This stage of mucosal reconstitution, stromal hyperplasia, and glandular lengthening constitutes the **proliferative phase** of the uterine endometrial cycle, typically spanning days five through fourteen.
steps.say: Rising ovarian estradiol regenerates the endometrial functional layer from basal cells during the proliferative phase.

vis.caption: Ectopic endometrial tissue demonstrating responsive cyclic hormonal proliferation and inflammation.
vis.alt: Endometriotic tissue proliferation driven by estrogenic stimulation

steps.tx: Following ovulation, progesterone secreted by the corpus luteum acts on the estrogen-primed endometrial stroma to arrest mitotic division and induce marked cellular differentiation. During this **secretory phase**, endometrial glands become markedly corkscrew-shaped, accumulating glycogen vacuoles at the subnuclear base before apocrine secretion into the uterine lumen to nourish the potential blastocyst.
steps.say: During the secretory phase, progesterone transforms the endometrium into corkscrew glycogen-secreting glands ready for implantation.

steps.tx: Follicular steroidogenesis requires coordinated metabolic cooperation between adjacent theca interna and granulosa cells, formalized as the **two-cell theory of steroidogenesis**. Luteinizing hormone acts on theca cells to promote cholesterol uptake and conversion into androstenedione, which then diffuses across the basement membrane into adjacent granulosa cells.
steps.say: The two-cell theory explains that LH stimulates theca cells to produce androgens, which diffuse to granulosa cells.

left.title: Theca Interna Cell Function
points: Synthesizes androstenedione and testosterone from cholesterol
Lacks aromatase and cannot convert androgens to estrogens

right.title: Granulosa Cell Function
points: Expresses high levels of cytochrome P450 aromatase enzyme
Converts thecal androstenedione into estrone and estradiol
Lacks 17-alpha-hydroxylase and cannot synthesize androgens de novo

steps.tx: One enzyme sits at the narrow gate through which all ovarian oestrogen must pass. **Aromatase activity** in granulosa cells converts theca made androgens into oestradiol under FSH control, completing the two cell partnership. Blocking that enzyme is treatment in breast cancer and a cause of failed ovulation when it is absent or inhibited. Its presence in fat and other tissues explains oestrogen production long after the ovaries retire.
steps.say: Aromatase in granulosa cells converts androgens to oestradiol and completes ovarian steroid production. Its blockers treat breast cancer and disturb ovulation.

vis.alt: Image showing aromatase activity converting androgens to oestrogen in granulosa cells.
vis.caption: Androgen molecules are shown converted to oestradiol by aromatase in a granulosa cell. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: Within the avascular granulosa layer, follicle-stimulating hormone activates cyclic adenosine monophosphate signaling to induce transcription of the cytochrome P450 aromatase enzyme. Granulosa **aromatase activity** converts thecal androstenedione into estrone and estradiol, releasing high concentrations of potent estrogen into the follicular antrum and systemic circulation.
steps.say: FSH induces aromatase within granulosa cells to convert thecal androgens into estradiol.

vis.caption: Ectopic myometrial glandular infiltration showing persistent responsive hormonal expansion.
vis.alt: Myometrial glandular penetration and cyclic hormonal changes

steps.tx: Natural exhaustion of the ovarian follicular pool marks the cessation of regular menstrual cycling and reproductive senescence, designated clinically as **menopause**. The absence of developing follicles removes circulating estradiol and inhibin B feedback, resulting in compensatory persistent hypergonadotropic elevations of both follicle-stimulating hormone and luteinizing hormone.
steps.say: Menopause occurs when ovarian follicles are depleted, resulting in low estrogen and compensatory high FSH and LH.

steps.tx: Combined oral contraceptive formulations exploit physiological negative feedback mechanisms to inhibit ovulation with high reliability. Synthetic progestins suppress hypothalamic gonadotropin-releasing hormone pulse frequency and block the preovulatory luteinizing hormone surge, while estrogenic components suppress follicle-stimulating hormone to prevent follicular recruitment, establishing effective **hormonal contraception**.
steps.say: Hormonal contraceptives suppress GnRH pulses and block the LH surge to prevent ovulation reliably.

steps.tx: Urinary monitoring kits designed to anticipate ovulation detect the abrupt appearance of luteinizing hormone in concentrated morning urine samples. These **ovulation prediction tests** turn positive approximately twenty-four to thirty-six hours before follicular rupture, identifying the optimal fertile window for intercourse or artificial insemination.
steps.say: Ovulation prediction tests detect the urinary LH surge twenty-four to thirty-six hours before follicular rupture.

left.title: Urinary LH Surge Detection
points: Employs monoclonal antibodies targeting LH beta subunit
Monitors preovulatory LH surge threshold in urine
Provides prospective prediction 24-36 hours prior to rupture
Accurately defines timing of maximal female fertility

right.title: Cervical Mucus Spinnbarkeit
points: High preovulatory estradiol thins and clears cervical mucus
Mucus demonstrates high elasticity stretching up to 10-12 cm
Exhibits microscopic ferning pattern upon air drying
Facilitates rapid sperm transit and capacitation

steps.tx: Progesterone exerts a direct thermogenic effect on the hypothalamic thermoregulatory center, mediated by local norepinephrine and prostaglandin signaling. Following ovulation, waking oral or tympanic temperatures rise by zero point three to zero point five degrees Celsius, creating a biphasic **basal body temperature shift** that confirms recent corpus luteum formation.
steps.say: Progesterone raises basal body temperature by up to half a degree Celsius after ovulation, confirming luteal activity.
